description.narrative: Moldova - Transition to High Value Agriculture Project - Rehab CIS Activity: The "Centralized Irrigation System Rehabilitation Activity" will rehabilitate up to 11 irrigation systems covering a command area of up to approximately 15,500 hectares. MCC Funding will be used to rehabilitate up to 11 systems to provide reliable water to farm operations in their command areas.
